ambiguities.text: The exact quadratic formula for memory extension cost is referenced but not explicitly defined in the memory.py specification
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard Ethereum memory cost formula: memory_cost = (memory_size_word^2 / 512) + (3 * memory_size_word), where memory_size_word = ceil(size / 32). This needs verification against the actual implementation.

ambiguities.text: MCOPY behavior when source and destination regions overlap is not explicitly specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume MCOPY handles overlapping regions correctly similar to memmove semantics, reading source before writing to destination. This is a standard expectation but should be verified.

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory is initialized to all zeros and reads beyond current memory boundary return zero-filled data
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Uninitialized memory reads could leak sensitive data from previous operations or other contexts

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory expansion is bounded by gas costs, preventing unbounded memory consumption
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Quadratic gas cost formula failure could allow memory exhaustion attacks on nodes

implicit_assumptions.description: Stack values used as memory positions are validated to prevent integer overflow
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Integer overflow in position calculations could cause unexpected memory access patterns
